name: AI Native Director - Shot Composition Add-on
language: English operating instructions with portable prompt structure; concise Hinglish production responses remain appropriate.

study.unit: One distinct visible still/frame image; each distinct collage panel counts individually. A person, face, board title or duplicate pin does not count as another image.
study.method: Purposive visual reading in connected Pinterest; individual composition annotations; manual repeated-frame and grade-only exclusions; pin-to-preview source reconciliation; selected larger pin checks.
study.sampling: Six targeted searches spanning general cinematography, Indian cinema, crowd staging, triptych references, formal symmetry and vertical portrait photography. This is not a random or popularity-weighted sample.
limits: Most images were inspected at on-screen preview scale; selected pins were enlarged.
Pin film labels, authorship, original crop, camera settings and AI-versus-live-action provenance were not independently authenticated.
Emotional uses are analyst interpretations, not established creator intention.
No temporal, audio, focal-length or generative-model performance claims are established by these stills.
Repeated shot geometry with genuinely different performance/action states may contribute distinct images; the study does not claim 545 different composition types.
study.adoption_state: Integrated into AI Native Director as optional directing heuristics. Structural and six-case behavioral text checks completed; no model training or generation-quality comparison.

integration.target: AI Native Director / attention, composition and focus
integration.status: installed in ai-native-director; structural and behavioral text validation passed
integration.load_rule: Load core instructions for new scene composition or substantive reframing. Load only matching patterns and a small evidence subset. Reuse existing approved context for micro-edits.
integration.precedence: Current explicit user instructions and approved screenplay, tags, cast, physical state, location, grade and reveal locks override research heuristics.
integration.future_validation: Test only within authorized production scope; use one changed rule and a boundary case. Text compliance does not prove improved visual or temporal fidelity.
integration.source_study_reinspection: No new image inspection in this integration run; original study extent retained.

core_instructions: Start with the beat: what must be understood first, what must be understood second, and what must remain unseen?
Resolve character intention, physical support, contact, prop ownership, location anchors and the action axis before choosing composition.
Name a primary attention target and any essential secondary evidence. If both are required, stage them at compatible depths or provide enough depth of field.
Assign foreground, midground and background jobs. An occluder must establish viewpoint, pressure, separation or reveal timing; otherwise simplify it.
Choose one dominant attention mechanism and a supporting one when useful. Treat this as a simplification heuristic, not a fixed quota.
Specify subject placement, relative scale, facing/attention direction, open space, support/contact and required crop boundaries before decorative lens language.
Select height, pitch, distance and lens look consistent with the chosen geometry. Never infer exact lens, aperture or camera motion from an unsourced still.
Check the action envelope: the hand, face, prop and contact must remain readable through the intended movement, not only at the selected still instant.
Compare adjacent coverage for new information, eye-line/attention direction, source of a reaction, action phase, identity, prop state and architecture continuity.
Preserve all approved tags, identity, costume, grade, geography, perception and reveal locks. A reference transfers a relationship or attention mechanism, not its cast or world.
Use a plain eye-level hold when performance supplies the information. Do not force creative-angle checklists or replace blocked evidence with an attractive frame.
Retrieve only the relevant pattern and a few evidence cases during production. Do not load the full 545-frame evidence file into every prompt rewrite.

decision_sequence.decide: Beat, first read, second read, hidden information and whose perception controls visibility.
Which face, hand, prop, contact or spatial relationship proves the beat.
Approved layout, supports, routes, axis, light direction, identities and reference bindings.
Body positions, depth alignment, gaze or sound-attention, scale and gesture envelope.
Dominant mechanism, layer jobs, empty-space purpose, crop and silhouette separation.
Plausible position, pitch, distance, lens look, sharp plane and deliberately softer layers.
One precise still instant; a separate start/path/end plan for any motion.
New information, compatible entry/exit and binary evidence checks.

patterns.name: Attention through a gap
patterns.geometry: Place the target inside an existing doorway, pole gap, shoulder gap or aperture. Separate near border from the target.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Focus the information-bearing face or object; keep the border identifiable.
patterns.avoid_when: Reject when the gap hides a required hand, mouth, identity cue or action.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Nested architectural frames
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Thresholds, anticipation, private versus shared space
patterns.geometry: Use successive real doors or arches; retain a clear path and an unambiguous floor plane.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Use enough focus to read the relevant thresholds.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not invent architecture, shift doors or centre the subject by breaking the approved layout.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Broken repetition
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: An individual within a system or crowd
patterns.geometry: Establish repeated bodies, seats, poles or windows, then let one meaningful difference select the target.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Difference may be posture, spacing, value, colour or sharpness.
patterns.avoid_when: Uniform faces and identical reactions destroy identity and believable crowd behaviour.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Scale against environment
patterns.geometry: Keep a clear small silhouette against one dominant environmental mass; provide a ground anchor.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Enough environmental detail must survive to communicate scale.
patterns.avoid_when: A tiny person is unusable if their outline or location cannot be read at delivery size.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested
patterns.production_boundary: Use a support or spatial scale anchor appropriate to the approved environment. Deep-space flight has no invented ground or horizon; retain only approved Sun/Earth relationships and motion vectors.

patterns.name: Empty space with a job
patterns.geometry: Reserve space toward a destination, attention source or meaningful absence. Track what occupies it later.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Keep the target distinct without making every empty region conspicuously bright.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not fill the space with decoration; do not reveal a later event prematurely.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Local light island
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Isolation, a thought, an object discovery
patterns.geometry: Give the required evidence a local light or value advantage and keep competing highlights quieter.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Check face, gesture and support remain readable inside or beside the light.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not infer mood solely from warm/cool hue or move the source when reversing camera.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Near object, far reaction
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Cause and response in one frame
patterns.geometry: Put an owned hand, prop or obstacle near camera and the reacting person farther away.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Choose one priority; retain the second read, or align depths/increase DOF if both are essential.
patterns.avoid_when: Blur must not erase the object whose identity explains the reaction.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Tactile evidence insert
patterns.geometry: Frame the contact point with enough wrist, sleeve or body context to establish ownership.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Keep fingers, object and contact in the required sharp plane.
patterns.avoid_when: A pretty macro that hides contact cannot cover the scripted action.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Shared depth for shared evidence
patterns.geometry: Stage required faces or contacts at compatible depth before choosing blur.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Use sufficient DOF rather than universally prescribing a wide aperture.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not put one required participant in decorative bokeh.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Reflection with one physical owner
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Indirect reveal, self-observation, a second presence
patterns.geometry: Place actual body, reflective surface and reflected view in a coherent geometry.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Prioritize the reflection when it carries new information; keep the real owner identifiable.
patterns.avoid_when: No duplicate physical person, mismatched hand, false reflected gaze or impossible reverse.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested
patterns.production_boundary: A reflection requires plausible physical geometry. When an essential reflected view cannot coexist with locked hand/body/camera positions, propose the smallest compatible camera or mirror adjustment rather than claiming the view is verified.

patterns.name: Overhead task map
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Working surface, object placement, route or group layout
patterns.geometry: Use high/overhead views to expose actual relationships among tools, hands, bodies and support surfaces.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Read the task plane rather than automatically demanding shallow focus.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not choose overhead when the required facial reaction becomes unreadable.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Low view with support
patterns.geometry: Specify actual low position, pitch and the support plane. Keep body scale and limbs plausible.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Protect face and action from near-object occlusion.
patterns.avoid_when: Low height alone is not a worm-eye view; distortion must not mutate identity.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: A pocket inside a crowd
patterns.geometry: Use near shoulders/backs to form a gap around the target; stagger heads across depth.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Keep target readable; preserve enough crowd structure to understand enclosure.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not remove the required crowd just to isolate the subject.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Unequal levels and distances
patterns.geometry: Vary sitting/standing levels and camera distance while keeping all essential faces separate.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Use depth that preserves the intended relationship.
patterns.avoid_when: Relative scale is a proposal, not proof of character status; respect actual platform levels.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Radial group aperture
patterns.geometry: Arrange separate faces around an opening or central object, with distinct head sizes and silhouettes.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Read the shared centre plus the necessary participants.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not merge faces or demand impossible camera access through bodies.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: A route through a mass
patterns.geometry: Use leading curves, open lanes and staggered bodies to define collective direction.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Retain route geography and key silhouettes.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not replace people with a duplicated texture or give everyone the same gesture.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Stillness against movement cues
patterns.geometry: Keep one readable target against passing or streaked surroundings.
patterns.focus_and_readability: The target stays recognizable; blur never replaces necessary action evidence.
patterns.avoid_when: A still cannot prove shutter speed, camera lock or a tracking path; video needs a separate plan.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Balanced frame, unequal meaning
patterns.geometry: Use a central axis or bilateral setting, then let posture, gesture or spacing supply the difference.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Protect the action that breaks the balance.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not impose symmetry on every beat or relocate approved world anchors.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Diagonals from the world
patterns.geometry: Use real stairs, railings, roads or body vectors as diagonals before adding camera roll.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Maintain readable feet, hand contact and destination.
patterns.avoid_when: A sloped setting or a rotated pin is not evidence for a Dutch angle.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Silhouette as information
patterns.geometry: Preserve distinctive outline, limb separation and contact against a simpler value plane.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Check readability at final display size.
patterns.avoid_when: Reject when the required beat depends on eyes, lips or a specific hand detail.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Colour as a local exception
patterns.geometry: Use one meaningful colour accent against quieter surroundings while preserving approved grade and costume.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Value and silhouette should still work without colour.
patterns.avoid_when: Reference palette does not authorize recolouring a locked character, garment or location.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Environmental insert with evidence
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Weather, time, route, scale, a new location fact
patterns.geometry: Choose a roof drip, road, tree, flame or landmark that supplies specific new information.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Keep that evidence legible rather than uniformly blurred.
patterns.avoid_when: A landscape beauty frame is not automatically useful coverage or a new story beat.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Texture kept below the story
patterns.geometry: Let one plane carry texture and a quieter plane carry the face/gesture; preserve regional specificity.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Control contrast, depth and overlap instead of erasing all detail.
patterns.avoid_when: Never copy vegetation, architecture or sacred design across incompatible worlds.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Fixed composition, changed performance
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: A thought developing within one spatial setup
patterns.geometry: Hold world, camera and prop placement while a meaningful pose or gesture changes.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Maintain the required face and contact through the action envelope.
patterns.avoid_when: Do not count near-identical alternatives as sequential coverage without changed information.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

patterns.name: Format-aware restaging
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Same beat delivered in horizontal and vertical frames
patterns.geometry: Reposition camera and depth stacking so face, hands, secondary relation and route fit the target ratio.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Protect the primary read and essential secondary evidence.
patterns.avoid_when: A tall collage is not a vertical shot; centre-cropping can destroy ownership and geography.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested
patterns.production_boundary: When body positions are locked, reframe from feasible camera space or adjust lens/distance intent; do not silently move actors to solve the target ratio.

patterns.name: Attention carried across a cut
patterns.possible_dramatic_use: Cause, response, reveal or an action match
patterns.geometry: Carry the relevant direction, screen region, action phase and prop ownership into the next frame.
patterns.focus_and_readability: Change attention only when a new beat motivates it.
patterns.avoid_when: A single still does not establish an edit or prove continuity across unviewed footage.
patterns.status: proposed directing heuristic supported by visual examples; generation reliability untested

video_addendum_structure: Begin from the inspected approved frame. State supported pose/contact, one primary action progression, camera start/path/end if any, maintained visibility, focus behaviour, end state and cut connection. Do not put these multiple time states into a still prompt.
qc_checks: Can the intended first read be identified at delivery size?
Is every essential secondary face, hand, prop, contact or route still readable?
Are face and costume identities preserved, including partial bodies and reflections?
Are limbs separated and all bodies/props supported by visible or verified surfaces?
Does any foreground line cut through a crucial eye, mouth, finger or contact point?
Does empty space have an intentional job without exposing a future reveal?
Do reflections match one physical owner, pose, hand and plausible camera geometry?
Does camera placement fit the approved location and maintained action axis?
Are light source, sound-attention and gaze rules consistent in the world?
Will the composition survive the intended movement and final aspect ratio?
Does this shot add a new fact, reaction or useful emotional duration to adjacent coverage?
Are visual, temporal and audio claims separated according to what was actually inspected?

behavioral_test_cases.case: Hand and face both carry the beat
behavioral_test_cases.pass: Stage both at compatible depth or use enough DOF; identify exact owned contact.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Portrait bokeh makes the hand-hold or object unreadable.

behavioral_test_cases.pass: Attention follows sound and established perception; do not import a binocular or normal-vision POV.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Eyes track a visually observed event or reaction precedes the audible stimulus.

behavioral_test_cases.pass: Keep crowd layers and a clear attention gap with believable adult-child scale.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Delete the crowd or shrink every adult to fit the close-up.

behavioral_test_cases.case: Approved stairs do not permit a low reverse
behavioral_test_cases.pass: Choose a feasible compatible position or mark the missing reference; preserve geometry.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Invent extra steps, invisible support or a moved entrance.

behavioral_test_cases.pass: Track actual versus reflected bodies and owned hands.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Generate a second physical person from the reflection.

behavioral_test_cases.pass: Restage depth or widen physically enough to retain face, hands and required relation.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Centre-crop away the second participant or contact.

behavioral_test_cases.case: Symmetric reference but asymmetric performance beat
behavioral_test_cases.pass: Keep approved world, allow gesture/spacing to break balance; use symmetry only when useful.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Move architecture or pin every face to the centre.

behavioral_test_cases.case: Single still used to request an orbit
behavioral_test_cases.pass: Check unseen geometry and separately plan motion; mark reliability pending.
behavioral_test_cases.fail: Claim the reference proves a full continuous camera path.

test_status.evidence_structure: All 26 patterns and referenced frames checked during integration; imported 545-frame/209-pin counts and immutable corpus verified.
test_status.prompt_behavior_cases: Six fresh-thread task outputs reviewed by Director: PASS for text behavior; no independent media evaluation.
